person_note: The controlling narration is third person, with shifting focalization among Vivi, her family, the Chief, Martha, and even Nantucket. Several Goodreads passages independently show sustained external third-person scene or interior narration, while the authorized opening and structural web analysis agree. The lone first-person event quotation is a local direct reflection by Vivi, comparable to represented thought within the surrounding third-person design, and does not form a sustained first-person section. No credible evidence indicates person-level alternation; the main limitation is that the Tier A excerpt covers only the opening, offset by whole-book structural evidence and interior quotations.
